note: Orrery, a small planetarium, all in this file: the 3D view is the bodies projected with sin and cos in computed values and drawn as discs and paths, and each body's thumbnail is a node drawn into the image body:<id> (snapshot). The bodies strip at the bottom is Sinopia's slide sorter, installed through the bodies.dock point and orrery-sorter.adapter.json.

sky.bodies.description: Every body in the orrery, in order: id, name, the id of the body it orbits (empty for the Sun) and a thumbnail image.

bodies.reorder.description: Moves body args.id to the place of body args.onto.

bodies.clone.description: Adds a twin of body args.id on the same orbit, half a turn away.

bodies.dock.description: The strip under the timeline, across the window.

computed.local: {{map(state.bodies, merge(it, {f: it.parent == '' ? 0 : (it.phase + state.time / it.period) % 1, pi: indexOf(computed.ids, it.parent)}))}}
computed.rel: {{map(computed.local, merge(it, {lx: it.radius * cos(2 * pi() * it.f), lz: -it.radius * sin(2 * pi() * it.f)}))}}
computed.positions: {{map(computed.rel, merge(it, {x: it.lx + (it.pi >= 0 ? computed.rel[it.pi].lx : 0), z: it.lz + (it.pi >= 0 ? computed.rel[it.pi].lz : 0), cx: it.pi >= 0 ? computed.rel[it.pi].lx : 0, cz: it.pi >= 0 ? computed.rel[it.pi].lz : 0}))}}
computed.chartItems: {{concat(state.stars, map(filter(computed.positions, it.parent != ''), {id: 'ring-' + it.id, x: it.cx * 22 - it.radius * 22, y: it.cz * 22 - it.radius * 22, width: it.radius * 44, height: it.radius * 44, radius: it.radius * 22, color: 'transparent', borderColor: '#2f3a55', borderWidth: 1}), map(computed.positions, {id: 'body-' + it.id, x: it.x * 22 - (it.parent == '' ? 9 : 4 + it.size * 10), y: it.z * 22 - (it.parent == '' ? 9 : 4 + it.size * 10), width: it.parent == '' ? 18 : 8 + it.size * 20, height: it.parent == '' ? 18 : 8 + it.size * 20, radius: it.parent == '' ? 9 : 4 + it.size * 10, color: it.hex, borderColor: it.id == state.selected ? '#fbbf24' : 'transparent', borderWidth: 2}), map(filter(computed.positions, it.parent == 'sun'), {id: 'label-' + it.id, x: it.x * 22 + 9, y: it.z * 22 - 7, width: 70, height: 14, color: 'transparent', borderWidth: 0, text: it.name, textSize: 10, textColor: '#aab2c5'}), state.notes)}}
computed.catalogue: {{map(state.bodies, {id: it.id, name: it.name, parent: it.parent, thumbnail: 'body:' + (it.look ?? it.id)})}}
computed.graphNodes: {{map(state.bodies, {id: it.id, title: it.name, x: it.gx ?? 400, y: it.gy ?? 20 + index * 40, width: 120, inputs: it.parent == '' ? [] : [{id: 'orbits', label: 'orbits', kind: 'orbit', links: 1}], outputs: [{id: 'satellites', label: 'satellites', kind: 'orbit'}]})}}
computed.graphLinks: {{map(filter(state.bodies, it.parent != ''), {from: it.parent, output: 'satellites', to: it.id, input: 'orbits'})}}
computed.tracks: {{[{id: 'eclipses', label: 'Eclipses', locked: true, clips: map(filter(state.events, it.kind == 'eclipse'), {id: it.id, label: it.label, start: it.time - 2, duration: 4, color: '#7c3aed'})}, {id: 'conjunctions', label: 'Conjunctions', locked: true, clips: map(filter(state.events, it.kind == 'conjunction'), {id: it.id, label: it.label, start: it.time - 2, duration: 4, color: '#0e7490'})}, {id: 'oppositions', label: 'Oppositions', locked: true, clips: map(filter(state.events, it.kind == 'opposition'), {id: it.id, label: it.label, start: it.time - 2, duration: 4, color: '#b45309'})}]}}
computed.view: {{ {w: max(window.width - 461, 200), h: max(window.height - 312, 160), f: state.zoom * min(max(window.width - 461, 200), max(window.height - 312, 160)), distance: state.camera.distance, cy: cos(state.camera.yaw), sy: sin(state.camera.yaw), cp: cos(state.camera.pitch), sp: sin(state.camera.pitch)} }}
computed.starVectors: {{map(computed.stars, {x: sqrt(1 - it.u * it.u) * cos(it.t), y: it.u, z: sqrt(1 - it.u * it.u) * sin(it.t)})}}
computed.starCamera: {{map(computed.starVectors, {x: it.x * computed.view.cy - it.z * computed.view.sy, yy: (it.x * computed.view.sy + it.z * computed.view.cy) * computed.view.sp - it.y * computed.view.cp, dd: -((it.x * computed.view.sy + it.z * computed.view.cy) * computed.view.cp + it.y * computed.view.sp)})}}
computed.starScreen: {{filter(map(filter(computed.starCamera, it.dd > 0.1), {px: computed.view.w / 2 + it.x * computed.view.f / it.dd, py: computed.view.h / 2 + it.yy * computed.view.f / it.dd}), it.px > 0 && it.px < computed.view.w && it.py > 0 && it.py < computed.view.h)}}
computed.target: {{state.follow != '' && computed.followed ? {x: computed.followed.x, z: computed.followed.z} : {x: state.camera.tx + (computed.selectedPosition ? computed.selectedPosition.x - state.camera.tx : 0) * state.fly, z: state.camera.tz + (computed.selectedPosition ? computed.selectedPosition.z - state.camera.tz : 0) * state.fly}}}
computed.turned: {{map(computed.positions, merge(it, {x1: (it.x - computed.target.x) * computed.view.cy - (it.z - computed.target.z) * computed.view.sy, z1: (it.x - computed.target.x) * computed.view.sy + (it.z - computed.target.z) * computed.view.cy}))}}
computed.projected: {{sort(map(computed.turned, merge(it, {depth: computed.view.distance - it.z1 * computed.view.cp, px: computed.view.w / 2 + it.x1 * computed.view.f / (computed.view.distance - it.z1 * computed.view.cp), py: computed.view.h / 2 + it.z1 * computed.view.sp * computed.view.f / (computed.view.distance - it.z1 * computed.view.cp), r: min(max(3, it.size * computed.view.f / (computed.view.distance - it.z1 * computed.view.cp)), computed.view.h * 0.4)})), it.depth, 'desc')}}
computed.orbitPaths: {{map(filter(computed.positions, it.parent != ''), {id: it.id, ox: it.cx - computed.target.x, oz: it.cz - computed.target.z, radius: it.radius})}}
computed.range: {{computed.sight ? sqrt(computed.sight.x1 * computed.sight.x1 + computed.view.distance * computed.view.distance - 2 * computed.view.distance * computed.sight.z1 * computed.view.cp + computed.sight.z1 * computed.sight.z1) : 0}}
computed.info: {{computed.sight ? {name: computed.selectedBody.name, distance: computed.range / 4.3, lit: computed.sight.parent == '' ? 1 : (1 + ((computed.sun.x1 - computed.sight.x1) * -computed.sight.x1 + (computed.sun.z1 - computed.sight.z1) * (computed.view.distance * computed.view.cp - computed.sight.z1)) / (hypot(computed.sun.x1 - computed.sight.x1, computed.sun.z1 - computed.sight.z1) * computed.range)) / 2} : null}}
computed.rate: {{state.playing ? (state.speed < 0 ? 'Reversed, ' : '') + formatNumber(abs(state.speed) * 1728000, 0, 0) + 'x faster: ' + fixed(abs(state.speed) * 20, abs(state.speed) < 0.05 ? 2 : 0) + ' days a second' : 'Paused'}}
computed.fov: {{ {deg: degrees(2 * atan(min(computed.view.w, computed.view.h) / (2 * computed.view.f))), times: state.zoom / 1.1} }}
computed.bodyCells: {{map(range(length(state.bodies) * length(state.bodies)), state.bodies[index % length(state.bodies)].parent == state.bodies[floor(index / length(state.bodies))].id ? index % length(state.bodies) : -1)}}
computed.bodyRows: {{map(state.bodies, {id: it.id, label: it.name, icon: it.parent == '' ? 'sun' : (it.parent == 'sun' ? 'circle' : 'moon'), iconColor: it.hex})}}

then.to: {{concat(slice(filter(state.bodies, it.id != args.id), 0, indexOf(computed.ids, args.onto)), [find(state.bodies, it.id == args.id)], slice(filter(state.bodies, it.id != args.id), indexOf(computed.ids, args.onto)))}}

then.value: {{merge(find(state.bodies, it.id == args.id), {id: args.id + '-' + state.nextId, name: find(state.bodies, it.id == args.id).name + ' ' + state.nextId, phase: (find(state.bodies, it.id == args.id).phase + 0.5) % 1, look: find(state.bodies, it.id == args.id).look ?? args.id})}}

addNote.value: {{ {id: 'note-' + state.nextId, x: round(state.chart.camera.x + 230 / state.chart.camera.zoom - 50), y: round(state.chart.camera.y + 150 / state.chart.camera.zoom - 11), width: 100, height: 22, radius: 4, color: '@note', text: state.draft || 'Note', textSize: 10, textColor: '#1d2026'} }}

then.value: {{ {id: 'mark-' + state.nextId, x: round(computed.selectedPosition.x * 22 - 16), y: round(computed.selectedPosition.z * 22 - 16), width: 32, height: 32, radius: 16, color: 'transparent', borderColor: '@mark', borderWidth: 2, text: ''} }}

{{ {id: 'note-' + state.nextId, x: round(computed.selectedPosition.x * 22 + 18), y: round(computed.selectedPosition.z * 22 - 26), width: 130, height: 20, radius: 4, color: '@note', text: computed.selectedBody.name + ', day ' + round(state.time), textSize: 10, textColor: '#1d2026'} }}

do.to: {{map(state.notes, it.id == moved.id ? merge(it, {x: moved.x, y: moved.y, width: moved.width, height: moved.height}) : it)}}
{{map(state.bodies, it.id == n.id ? merge(it, {gx: n.x, gy: n.y}) : it)}}

{{concat(state.bookmarks, [{id: 'place-' + length(state.bookmarks), label: (computed.selectedBody ? computed.selectedBody.name : 'Space') + ', day ' + floor(state.time), camera: state.camera, follow: state.follow, selected: state.selected}])}}

children.text: {{computed.goal ? (state.speed < 0 ? 'Previous: ' : 'Next: ') + computed.goal.label + ' on day ' + round(computed.goal.time) + ' (' + (state.speed < 0 ? round(state.time - computed.goal.time) + ' days ago)' : 'in ' + round(computed.goal.time - state.time) + ' days)') : 'No more events in this window'}}

{{computed.selectedBody ? computed.selectedBody.name + (computed.selectedBody.parent ? ', orbits ' + (find(state.bodies, it.id == computed.selectedBody.parent).name ?? computed.selectedBody.parent) + ' every ' + computed.selectedBody.period + ' days' : ', at the centre') : 'Nothing selected'}}

children.d: {{join(map(range(65), (index > 0 && (computed.view.distance - ((o.ox + o.radius * cos(index * pi() / 32)) * computed.view.sy + (o.oz + o.radius * sin(index * pi() / 32)) * computed.view.cy) * computed.view.cp) > 0.2 && (computed.view.distance - ((o.ox + o.radius * cos((index - 1) * pi() / 32)) * computed.view.sy + (o.oz + o.radius * sin((index - 1) * pi() / 32)) * computed.view.cy) * computed.view.cp) > 0.2 ? 'L ' : 'M ') + fixed(computed.view.w / 2 + ((o.ox + o.radius * cos(index * pi() / 32)) * computed.view.cy - (o.oz + o.radius * sin(index * pi() / 32)) * computed.view.sy) * computed.view.f / max((computed.view.distance - ((o.ox + o.radius * cos(index * pi() / 32)) * computed.view.sy + (o.oz + o.radius * sin(index * pi() / 32)) * computed.view.cy) * computed.view.cp), 0.2), 1) + ' ' + fixed(computed.view.h / 2 + ((o.ox + o.radius * cos(index * pi() / 32)) * computed.view.sy + (o.oz + o.radius * sin(index * pi() / 32)) * computed.view.cy) * computed.view.sp * computed.view.f / max((computed.view.distance - ((o.ox + o.radius * cos(index * pi() / 32)) * computed.view.sy + (o.oz + o.radius * sin(index * pi() / 32)) * computed.view.cy) * computed.view.cp), 0.2), 1)), ' ')}}

onExpand.to: {{event.expanded ? concat(filter(state.expandedBodies, it != event.id), [event.id]) : filter(state.expandedBodies, it != event.id)}}

children.text: Drag to turn, scroll to zoom; G go to, C centre, F follow; B browser; comma and period field of view; O orbits, P labels; L K J time

children.label: Add a note in the middle of the chart
children.tooltip: Add a note in the middle of the chart

children.text: What orbits what (drag a link to move a body)

children.label: Upcoming events, one second a day

pages.description: The pages in order, each with an id, a name and an image the host renders.

current.description: The id of the selected page.

reorder.description: Page id takes the place of page onto.

pages.value: {{map(filter(app.sky.bodies, it.parent != ''), {id: it.id, name: it.name, image: it.thumbnail})}}

adapter.note: Sinopia's slide sorter in Orrery: every body but the Sun is a page, drawn from the thumbnail the screen draws for it, and the sorter's actions are the body actions Orrery's bodies dock receives.

to.value: {{map(filter(app.sky.bodies, it.parent != ''), {id: it.id, name: it.name, image: it.thumbnail})}}
